calculation.expression: -(close_t - open_t) / mean(TrueRange_{t-20}, 15..20), with ATR shifted one session
calculation.description: Fade the completed session's close-to-open directional shock, normalized by a lagged 20-session ATR. The signal is available after the close and predicts the next session cross-sectional return. True range is max(high-low, abs(high-prior_close), abs(low-prior_close)).

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year: 2020 0.02876, 2021 0.04518, 2022 0.05315, 2023 0.03766, 2024 0.04384, 2025 0.04367, 2026 0.03904. Longer-horizon predictive power decays materially, supporting a one-day application. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation despite 1,780 dates.
